title: Taurus, holding on isn't being held
caption: for the taurus still watering last spring

scenes.text: venus rules you, so you love with your hands.
in warm plates, fixed shelves, promises you actually keep.
you build slowly, and what you build stays standing.
that's the gift. it's also the trap.
you'll keep tending a garden that stopped growing in april.
out of loyalty, out of habit, out of pure stubbornness.
but holding on isn't the same as being held.
ask what you're still watering, and why.
letting go cleanly is its own kind of loyalty.
someone worth it won't need to be kept. they'll just stay.
rest now, taurus. the ground will hold.
